text: This report provides an update to the Board of Health on the Toronto Public Health (TPH) Capital Budget variance for the year ending on December 31, 2025. As of December 31, 2025, Toronto Public Health spent $5.551 million representing 74.9 percent of the 2025 Approved Capital Budget of $7.415 million.
The Board of Health: 1. Received the report (March 13, 2026) from the Medical Officer of Health for information.
